Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
Name: Nightmare Curse
[BL]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Auspex & Chimerstry
[chi] (D) Tap a ready minion and untap this acting vampire.
[aus][chi] (D) Put this card on a ready minion and tap that minion. This
minion doesn't untap as normal. During this minion's controller's untap, he
or she may burn a pool to untap this minion. Burn this card when the acting
vampire leaves play.
[AUS][CHI] (D) Put this card on a ready minion and tap that minion. This
minion doesn't untap as normal. Burn this card when the acting vampire
leaves play.

Can a vampire play Nightmare Curse at any of its three discipline levels on
a TAPPED minion?

Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
"Damnans" <damna...@ono.com> wrote in message news:zyDq9.6788>

>Can a vampire play Nightmare Curse at any of its three discipline levels on
> a TAPPED minion?

On the argument that you can tap a tapped minion
I would say you can play any of the three with the
tap a minion effect targeting an already tapped minion.

-JTP

Messages.Author: The Bard of Crete
Messages.Body:

None of the texts say that the card must be played on an "untapped" minion.
And since you can tap a tapped minion I believe it is possible.
